integrity: The elementary proof is complete for the exact stated language; finite enumerations independently check bounded instances only.
scientific_limitations: Only noun-level Boolean operations; sentence-level Boolean operations are not included.
No claim of an optimal-size axiomatisation or of complexity of the decision problem.
Historical priority remains subject to comparison with older comparative-cardinality literature.
title: All finite spectra of the noun-Boolean cardinality syllogistic are additive semigroups
